Install Instructions (Universal — GTA V Enhanced & Legacy):

1. Ensure ScriptHookV (ScriptHookV.dll + ASI Loader) is installed in your game folder.
2. Extract the files from "Put in main folder" (XtremeTool.asi and XtremeTool.ini) into your main GTA V directory:
   - GTA V Enhanced: where GTA5_Enhanced.exe is located.
   - GTA V Legacy:   where GTA5.exe is located.
3. The plugin automatically detects whether you are running GTA V Enhanced or GTA V Legacy at startup.
4. Check out Documentation_Config.txt for an explanation of all parameters in XtremeTool.ini.
